integrity: The proof is an infinite elementary argument. Even exponents are eliminated modulo 8; odd exponents force an odd cofactor to divide n and then contradict an explicit size bound. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats bases that are powers of two and does not claim the same result for bases with odd prime factors. Older Woodall sources inspected here did not supply a reliable exact public calendar day; the stored exact date is the verified 2014-01-31 J-STAGE release.
title: No perfect powers in the dyadic-base generalized Woodall family
